suppressed-exceptions-concept.title: Suppressed exceptions
suppressed-exceptions-concept.summary: When both the try body and resource closing fail, the primary exception is preserved and the close failure is recorded as a suppressed exception.
suppressed-exceptions-concept.why: This prevents a later close failure from replacing the exception that originally caused the operation to fail.
suppressed-exceptions-concept.tips: Inspect Throwable.getSuppressed() during diagnosis so resource-cleanup failures are not overlooked.

spliterator-concept.title: What Spliterator does
spliterator-concept.short: Describe traversal and partitioning of elements
spliterator-concept.summary: Spliterator provides operations for traversing elements and for splitting a range of elements into parts.
spliterator-concept.why: Streams can use its characteristics and splitting behavior to organize traversal and parallel execution.
spliterator-concept.tips: Custom implementations should report only characteristics such as ORDERED or SIZED that they truly guarantee.

objects-requirenonnull-else.title: Use a default with Objects.requireNonNullElse
objects-requirenonnull-else.short: Replace null with a non-null default
objects-requirenonnull-else.summary: Objects.requireNonNullElse returns its first argument when non-null and otherwise returns the required non-null default.
objects-requirenonnull-else.why: It expresses a simple null fallback as one expression while guaranteeing a non-null result.
objects-requirenonnull-else.tips: The default must also be non-null or the method throws NullPointerException.

predicate-not.title: Negate conditions with Predicate.not
predicate-not.summary: Predicate.not returns a predicate whose result is the opposite of an existing predicate.
predicate-not.why: It lets method references such as String::isBlank be negated without rewriting them as lambdas.
predicate-not.tips: For complicated chains of negation, a named predicate can still be clearer.

malformed-input-exception.title: MalformedInputException
malformed-input-exception.short: Detect input invalid for a character encoding
malformed-input-exception.summary: MalformedInputException indicates that an input byte sequence cannot be decoded using the selected character encoding.
malformed-input-exception.why: It commonly appears when the actual file encoding and the decoder charset do not match.
malformed-input-exception.tips: Confirm the source encoding and decoding policy before choosing to replace malformed input silently.

rejected-execution-exception.title: RejectedExecutionException
rejected-execution-exception.short: Do not submit work to an executor that cannot accept it
rejected-execution-exception.summary: RejectedExecutionException reports that an executor cannot accept a submitted task, for example after shutdown.
rejected-execution-exception.why: ExecutorService has a lifecycle that includes a point after which new work is no longer accepted.
rejected-execution-exception.tips: Keep executor ownership and shutdown in a clear scope so submissions cannot race with or follow shutdown.

private-interface-method-call-error.title: Calling a private interface method from an implementation
private-interface-method-call-error.short: Keep private interface helpers inside the interface
private-interface-method-call-error.summary: A private interface method introduced in Java 9 can be used only from method implementations within that interface.
private-interface-method-call-error.why: Private members are neither inherited by implementing classes nor visible externally.
private-interface-method-call-error.tips: Use private helpers from default or static methods inside the interface when sharing implementation details.

var-null-inference-error.title: var cannot infer a type from null
var-null-inference-error.short: Provide type information for a null initializer
var-null-inference-error.summary: A local variable declared with var needs an initializer from which the compiler can infer its type, and null alone provides no such type.
var-null-inference-error.why: The null literal does not identify one specific reference type.
var-null-inference-error.tips: If a variable must start as null, write its declared type explicitly, such as String value.

unchecked-varargs-heap-pollution-warning.title: Unchecked generic varargs warning
unchecked-varargs-heap-pollution-warning.short: Avoid unsafe operations on generic varargs arrays
unchecked-varargs-heap-pollution-warning.summary: Varargs whose element type is non-reifiable are implemented with arrays and can permit operations that lead to heap pollution.
unchecked-varargs-heap-pollution-warning.why: Runtime array checks and erased generic types cannot together guarantee complete type safety in this case.
unchecked-varargs-heap-pollution-warning.tips: Prefer a collection parameter when practical, and consider @SafeVarargs only when the implementation is demonstrably safe.

bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.title: BigDecimal.equals also compares scale
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.short: Distinguish numeric comparison from representation equality
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.summary: BigDecimal.equals compares both numerical value and scale, so 1.0 and 1.00 are not equal according to equals.
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.why: A BigDecimal object's equality includes the value-scale representation rather than numerical value alone.
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.tips: Use compareTo when the requirement is numerical ordering or numerical equality, and account for its difference from equals.
